```{r}

#Comparing Base and End


# -----------------------------
# 2. Keep Base and End only
# -----------------------------

metab <- metab %>%
  filter(Time %in% c("Base", "End"))

micro <- micro %>%
  filter(Time %in% c("Base", "End"))

# -----------------------------
# 3. Define feature columns
# -----------------------------

metab_feature_cols <- colnames(metab[,11:8877])
micro_feature_cols <- colnames(micro[,2:17035])

# -----------------------------
# 4. Build sample metadata
# -----------------------------

metab_meta <- metab %>%
  transmute(
    sample = paste0(as.character(sample_ID), "_", Time),
    ID = as.character(sample_ID),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Time = as.character(Time)
  )

micro_meta <- micro %>%
  transmute(
    sample = paste0(as.character(sample_ID), "_", Time),
    ID = as.character(sample_ID),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Time = as.character(Time)
  )

sample_metadata <- bind_rows(metab_meta, micro_meta) %>%
  distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}

# -----------------------------
# 5. Convert metabolomics to matrix
# -----------------------------

metab_mat <- metab %>%
  mutate(sample = paste0(as.character(sample_ID), "_", Time)) %>%
  select(sample, all_of(metab_feature_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(metab_feature_cols), ~ as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(metab_feature_cols), ~ replace_na(., 0)))

metab_sample_names <- metab_mat$sample

metab_mat <- metab_mat %>%
  select(-sample) %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(metab_mat) <- "double"

# Keep zeros as true zeros 
positive_idx <- !is.na(metab_mat) & metab_mat > 0
metab_mat[positive_idx] <- log2(metab_mat[positive_idx])

rownames(metab_mat) <- metab_sample_names
metab_view <- t(metab_mat)

```




```{r}

# -----------------------------
# 6. Convert microbiome to matrix
# -----------------------------

micro_mat <- micro %>%
  mutate(sample = paste0(as.character(sample_ID), "_", Time)) %>%
  select(sample, all_of(micro_feature_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(micro_feature_cols), ~ as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(micro_feature_cols), ~ replace_na(., 0)))

# Save sample names before converting to a matrix
micro_sample_names <- micro_mat$sample

micro_mat <- micro_mat %>%
  select(-sample) %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(micro_mat) <- "double"
rownames(micro_mat) <- micro_sample_names

# CLR transform using a fixed pseudocount for zero values
clr_transform <- function(x) {
  x[!is.finite(x)] <- NA_real_

  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  }

  # Replace observed zeros only; NA values remain NA
  x[x == 0 & !is.na(x)] <- 1e-6

  # Log-transform values
  lx <- log(x)

  # Center the logged values within the sample
  clr_values <- lx - mean(lx, na.rm = TRUE)

  return(clr_values)
}

micro_clr <- t(apply(micro_mat, 1, clr_transform))

# Restore feature and sample names
colnames(micro_clr) <- colnames(micro_mat)
rownames(micro_clr) <- rownames(micro_mat)

# MOFA expects features in rows and samples in columns
micro_view <- t(micro_clr)


```




```{r}
# 6. Align both views to the same sample universe ------------------------------

sample_ids_unique <- unique(append(rownames(metab_mat), rownames(micro_mat)))
sample_ids_unique_ordered <- sample_ids_unique[order(sample_ids_unique)]


align_view <- function(view_matrix, sample_ids) {
  aligned <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(view_matrix),
    ncol = length(sample_ids),
    dimnames = list(rownames(view_matrix), sample_ids)
  )

  shared <- intersect(colnames(view_matrix), sample_ids)
  aligned[, shared] <- view_matrix[, shared, drop = FALSE]
  aligned
}

metab_view_filled <- align_view(metab_view, sample_ids_unique_ordered)
micro_view_filled <- align_view(micro_view, sample_ids_unique_ordered)

mofa_data <- list(
  Metabolomics = metab_view_filled,
  Microbiome = micro_view_filled
)

stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(mofa_data$Metabolomics), sample_ids_unique_ordered),
  identical(colnames(mofa_data$Microbiome), sample_ids_unique_ordered)
)

#align the metadata as well
sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(sample %in% sample_ids_unique_ordered) %>%
  arrange(match(sample, sample_ids_unique_ordered))
```

```{r}
# 10. Extract factor scores and test associations ------------------------------

factor_scores <- get_factors(
  MOFAmodel,
  factors = "all",
  as.data.frame = TRUE
) %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = "sample")

#write.csv(factor_scores, "factor_scores_with_metadata.csv", row.names = FALSE)

factor_names <- unique(factor_scores$factor)



# Repeated-measures association screen:
# factor score ~ treatment + time + treatment-by-time + subject random intercept
for (pkg in c("lmerTest", "broom.mixed")) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}
library(lmerTest)

factor_associations <- map_dfr(factor_names, function(fac) {
  dat <- factor_scores %>%
    filter(factor == fac, !is.na(value), !is.na(Group), !is.na(Time))

  if (nrow(dat) < 10 || n_distinct(dat$ID) < 5) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  fit <- lmer(
    value ~ Group * Time + (1 | ID),
    data = dat,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed") %>%
    mutate(factor = fac, .before = 1)
})



factor_associations <- factor_associations %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted_global = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")
  )

#write.csv(
#   factor_associations,
#   "factor_associations_group_time.csv",
#   row.names = FALSE
# )

# Visualize each factor by treatment and time.
#pdf("03_factor_scores_by_group_time.pdf", width = 9, height = 6)

for (fac in factor_names) {
  p <- factor_scores %>%
    filter(factor == fac) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = Time,
        y = value,
        color = Group,
        group = interaction(ID, Group)
      )
    ) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
    stat_summary(
      aes(group = Group),
      fun = mean,
      geom = "line",
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      aes(group = Group),
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      size = 3
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste(fac, "scores"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "MOFA factor score"
    )

  print(p)
}

plot_weights_fn <- function(mofa, factor=1, view=1, nfeatures=10) {
  p1 <- plot_weights(mofa, 
    factors = factor, 
    view = view,
    nfeatures = nfeatures,
    text_size = 4
  )
  
  p2 <- plot_top_weights(mofa, 
    factors = factor, 
    view = view,
    nfeatures = nfeatures
  )
  
  p <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist=list(p1,p2), nrow=1)
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(broom.mixed)

############################################################
# Settings
############################################################

time_levels <- c("Base", "End")

############################################################
# 1. Fit mixed models and extract all results
############################################################

time_plot_results <- map(
  unique(factor_scores$factor),
  function(fac) {

    dat <- factor_scores %>%
      filter(
        factor == fac,
        !is.na(value),
        !is.na(Time),
        !is.na(Group),
        !is.na(ID)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Time = factor(
          Time,
          levels = time_levels
        ),
        Group = factor(Group),
        ID = factor(ID)
      )

    if (
      nrow(dat) < 10 ||
      n_distinct(dat$ID) < 5 ||
      n_distinct(dat$Time) < 2 ||
      n_distinct(dat$Group) < 2
    ) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    ##########################################################
    # Repeated-measures mixed model
    ##########################################################

    fit <- lmer(
      value ~ Group * Time + (1 | ID),
      data = dat,
      REML = FALSE
    )

    ##########################################################
    # Fixed effects directly from model
    ##########################################################

    fixed_results <- broom.mixed::tidy(
      fit,
      effects = "fixed"
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        effect = "fixed",
        term,
        estimate,
        std.error,
        statistic,
        df,
        p.value
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Random effects directly from model
    ##########################################################

    random_results <- broom.mixed::tidy(
      fit,
      effects = "ran_pars"
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        effect = "random",
        term = paste0(
          group,
          ": ",
          term
        ),
        estimate,
        std.error = NA_real_,
        statistic = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p.value = NA_real_
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Marginal means for Time
    #
    # Averaged equally across diet group
    ##########################################################

    time_emmeans <- emmeans(
      fit,
      specs = ~ Time,
      weights = "equal"
    )

    time_means <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        time_emmeans,
        infer = c(TRUE, FALSE),
        level = 0.95
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        Time,
        mean_factor_score = emmean,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        ci_lower = lower.CL,
        ci_upper = upper.CL
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Overall End vs Base marginal contrast
    #
    # Averaged across diet groups
    ##########################################################

    time_test <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        contrast(
          time_emmeans,
          method = list(
            "End - Base" = c(-1, 1)
          )
        ),
        infer = TRUE,
        adjust = "none"
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        contrast,
        estimate,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        t_ratio = t.ratio,
        p_value = p.value
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Group x Time marginal means
    #
    # Gives:
    # Dairy Base
    # Dairy End
    # Meat Base
    # Meat End
    ##########################################################

    interaction_emmeans <- emmeans(
      fit,
      specs = ~ Group * Time
    )

    interaction_means <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        interaction_emmeans,
        infer = c(TRUE, FALSE),
        level = 0.95
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        Group,
        Time,
        mean_factor_score = emmean,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        ci_lower = lower.CL,
        ci_upper = upper.CL
      )

    ##########################################################
    # End vs Base within each diet group
    #
    # These are the p-values that will be attached to
    # the Group x Time marginal means table.
    ##########################################################

    time_by_group_emmeans <- emmeans(
      fit,
      specs = ~ Time | Group
    )

    within_group_time_contrasts <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        contrast(
          time_by_group_emmeans,
          method = list(
            "End - Base" = c(-1, 1)
          )
        ),
        infer = TRUE,
        adjust = "none"
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        Group,
        contrast,
        estimate,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        t_ratio = t.ratio,
        p_value = p.value
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Formal Group x Time interaction test
    #
    # Difference in change over time:
    # Meat vs Dairy
    ##########################################################

    interaction_test <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        contrast(
          interaction_emmeans,
          interaction = c(
            "pairwise",
            "pairwise"
          ),
          adjust = "none"
        ),
        infer = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        Group_contrast = Group_pairwise,
        Time_contrast = Time_pairwise,
        estimate,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        t_ratio = t.ratio,
        p_value = p.value
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Return all results for this factor
    ##########################################################

    list(
      model_results = bind_rows(
        fixed_results,
        random_results
      ),
      time_means = time_means,
      time_test = time_test,
      interaction_means = interaction_means,
      within_group_time_contrasts =
        within_group_time_contrasts,
      interaction_test = interaction_test
    )
  }
)

############################################################
# 2. Combine direct model results across factors
############################################################

all_model_results <- time_plot_results %>%
  compact() %>%
  map_dfr("model_results")

############################################################
# 3. Global BH/FDR correction across all fixed-effect tests
############################################################

fixed_index <- all_model_results$effect == "fixed"

all_model_results$p_adjusted_global <- NA_real_

all_model_results$p_adjusted_global[
  fixed_index
] <- p.adjust(
  all_model_results$p.value[
    fixed_index
  ],
  method = "BH"
)

all_model_results <- all_model_results %>%
  arrange(
    p_adjusted_global,
    p.value
  )

############################################################
# 4. Combine overall Time marginal means
############################################################

time_mean_plot_data <- time_plot_results %>%
  compact() %>%
  map_dfr("time_means")

############################################################
# 5. Combine overall End vs Base marginal tests
############################################################

time_association_tests <- time_plot_results %>%
  compact() %>%
  map_dfr("time_test") %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    significance = case_when(
      adjusted_p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.10  ~ ".",
      TRUE                     ~ ""
    )
  )

############################################################
# 6. Attach overall Time p-values to Time marginal means
############################################################

time_mean_plot_data <- time_mean_plot_data %>%
  left_join(
    time_association_tests %>%
      select(
        factor,
        p_value,
        adjusted_p_value,
        significance
      ),
    by = "factor"
  )

############################################################
# 7. Combine Group x Time marginal means
############################################################

all_interaction_means <- time_plot_results %>%
  compact() %>%
  map_dfr("interaction_means")

############################################################
# 8. Combine within-group End vs Base contrasts
############################################################

all_within_group_time_contrasts <- time_plot_results %>%
  compact() %>%
  map_dfr("within_group_time_contrasts")

############################################################
# 9. BH/FDR correction for within-group time contrasts
#
# Correction is performed across all Factor x Group
# End-vs-Base tests.
############################################################

all_within_group_time_contrasts <-
  all_within_group_time_contrasts %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    significance = case_when(
      adjusted_p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.10  ~ ".",
      TRUE                     ~ ""
    )
  )

############################################################
# 10. Create diet x time marginal means results table
#
# Each Base/End row receives the p-value for the
# End-vs-Base contrast within that diet group.
############################################################

diet_time_marginal_means <- all_interaction_means %>%
  left_join(
    all_within_group_time_contrasts %>%
      select(
        factor,
        Group,
        p_value,
        adjusted_p_value,
        significance
      ),
    by = c(
      "factor",
      "Group"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    factor,
    Group,
    Time,
    mean_factor_score,
    standard_error,
    degrees_freedom,
    ci_lower,
    ci_upper,
    p_value,
    adjusted_p_value,
    significance
  )

############################################################
# 11. Combine formal Group x Time interaction tests
############################################################

all_interaction_tests <- time_plot_results %>%

    ),
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(broom.mixed)

############################################################
# Settings
############################################################

time_levels <- c("Base", "End")

############################################################
# 1. Fit mixed models and extract all results
############################################################

time_plot_results <- map(
  unique(factor_scores$factor),
  function(fac) {

    dat <- factor_scores %>%
      filter(
        factor == fac,
        !is.na(value),
        !is.na(Time),
        !is.na(Group),
        !is.na(ID)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Time = factor(
          Time,
          levels = time_levels
        ),
        Group = factor(Group),
        ID = factor(ID)
      )

    if (
      nrow(dat) < 10 ||
      n_distinct(dat$ID) < 5 ||
      n_distinct(dat$Time) < 2 ||
      n_distinct(dat$Group) < 2
    ) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    ##########################################################
    # Repeated-measures mixed model
    ##########################################################

    fit <- lmer(
      value ~ Group * Time + (1 | ID),
      data = dat,
      REML = FALSE
    )

    ##########################################################
    # Fixed effects directly from model
    ##########################################################

    fixed_results <- broom.mixed::tidy(
      fit,
      effects = "fixed"
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        effect = "fixed",
        term,
        estimate,
        std.error,
        statistic,
        df,
        p.value
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Random effects directly from model
    ##########################################################

    random_results <- broom.mixed::tidy(
      fit,
      effects = "ran_pars"
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        effect = "random",
        term = paste0(
          group,
          ": ",
          term
        ),
        estimate,
        std.error = NA_real_,
        statistic = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p.value = NA_real_
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Marginal means for Time
    #
    # Averaged equally across diet group
    ##########################################################

    time_emmeans <- emmeans(
      fit,
      specs = ~ Time,
      weights = "equal"
    )

    time_means <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        time_emmeans,
        infer = c(TRUE, FALSE),
        level = 0.95
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        Time,
        mean_factor_score = emmean,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        ci_lower = lower.CL,
        ci_upper = upper.CL
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Overall End vs Base marginal contrast
    #
    # Averaged across diet groups
    ##########################################################

    time_test <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        contrast(
          time_emmeans,
          method = list(
            "End - Base" = c(-1, 1)
          )
        ),
        infer = TRUE,
        adjust = "none"
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        contrast,
        estimate,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        t_ratio = t.ratio,
        p_value = p.value
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Marginal means for each Group x Time combination
    ##########################################################

    interaction_emmeans <- emmeans(
      fit,
      specs = ~ Group * Time
    )

    interaction_means <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        interaction_emmeans,
        infer = c(TRUE, FALSE),
        level = 0.95
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        Group,
        Time,
        mean_factor_score = emmean,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        ci_lower = lower.CL,
        ci_upper = upper.CL
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Time contrast within each diet group
    #
    # End - Base separately for Dairy and Meat
    ##########################################################

    time_by_group_emmeans <- emmeans(
      fit,
      specs = ~ Time | Group
    )

    within_group_time_contrasts <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        contrast(
          time_by_group_emmeans,
          method = list(
            "End - Base" = c(-1, 1)
          )
        ),
        infer = TRUE,
        adjust = "none"
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        Group,
        contrast,
        estimate,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        t_ratio = t.ratio,
        p_value = p.value
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Formal interaction / difference-in-differences
    #
    # Tests whether the Base -> End change differs by Group
    ##########################################################

    interaction_test <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        contrast(
          interaction_emmeans,
          interaction = c(
            "pairwise",
            "pairwise"
          ),
          adjust = "none"
        ),
        infer = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        Group_contrast = Group_pairwise,
        Time_contrast = Time_pairwise,
        estimate,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        t_ratio = t.ratio,
        p_value = p.value
      )

    ##########################################################
    # Return all results for this factor
    ##########################################################

    list(
      model_results = bind_rows(
        fixed_results,
        random_results
      ),
      time_means = time_means,
      time_test = time_test,
      interaction_means = interaction_means,
      within_group_time_contrasts = within_group_time_contrasts,
      interaction_test = interaction_test
    )
  }
)

############################################################
# 2. Combine direct model results across factors
############################################################

all_model_results <- time_plot_results %>%
  compact() %>%
  map_dfr("model_results")

############################################################
# 3. Global BH/FDR correction across all fixed-effect tests
############################################################

fixed_index <- all_model_results$effect == "fixed"

all_model_results$p_adjusted_global <- NA_real_

all_model_results$p_adjusted_global[
  fixed_index
] <- p.adjust(
  all_model_results$p.value[
    fixed_index
  ],
  method = "BH"
)

all_model_results <- all_model_results %>%
  arrange(
    p_adjusted_global,

  )

############################################################
# 4. Combine Time marginal means

  compact() %>%
  map_dfr("time_means")

############################################################

  compact() %>%

  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    significance = case_when(
      adjusted_p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.10  ~ ".",
      TRUE                     ~ ""
    )
  )

############################################################
# 6. Combine Group x Time marginal means
############################################################

all_interaction_means <- time_plot_results %>%
  compact() %>%

############################################################
# 7. Combine within-group time contrasts
############################################################

all_within_group_time_contrasts <- time_plot_results %>%

  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )

############################################################
# 8. Combine formal interaction tests
############################################################

all_interaction_tests <- time_plot_results %>%
  compact() %>%
  map_dfr("interaction_test") %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )

############################################################
# 9. Join overall Time p-values to plotting data
############################################################

time_mean_plot_data <- time_mean_plot_data %>%

    ),

    ),

    annotation_y =
      max_ci + 0.15 * factor_range,

    annotation_label = significance
  )

############################################################
# 11. Order factors numerically
############################################################

factor_levels <- time_mean_plot_data %>%
  distinct(factor) %>%
  mutate(
    factor_number = as.numeric(
      gsub(
        "[^0-9]",

time_mean_plot_data <- time_mean_plot_data %>%
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

############################################################
# Settings
############################################################

time_levels <- c("Base", "End")

############################################################
# 1. Fit mixed model and obtain estimated means by Time
#
# The estimated time means are averaged across Meat and Dairy.
############################################################

time_plot_results <- map(
  unique(factor_scores$factor),
  function(fac) {

    dat <- factor_scores %>%
      filter(
        factor == fac,
        !is.na(value),
        !is.na(Time),
        !is.na(Group),
        !is.na(ID)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Time = factor(
          Time,
          levels = time_levels
        ),
        Group = factor(Group),
        ID = factor(ID)
      )

    if (
      nrow(dat) < 10 ||
      n_distinct(dat$ID) < 5 ||
      n_distinct(dat$Time) < 2
    ) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    ##########################################################
    # Repeated-measures model
    ##########################################################

    fit <- lmer(
      value ~ Group * Time + (1 | ID),
      data = dat,
      REML = FALSE
    )

    ##########################################################
    # Estimated marginal mean for Base and End
    #
    # These means are averaged over diet group.
    ##########################################################

    time_emmeans <- emmeans(
      fit,
      specs = ~ Time,
      weights = "equal"
    )

    time_means <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        time_emmeans,
        infer = c(TRUE, FALSE),
        level = 0.95
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        Time,
        mean_factor_score = emmean,
        standard_error = SE,
        degrees_freedom = df,
        ci_lower = lower.CL,
        ci_upper = upper.CL
      )

    ##########################################################
    # End versus Base contrast
    ##########################################################

    time_test <- as.data.frame(
      summary(
        contrast(
          time_emmeans,
          method = list(
            "End - Base" = c(-1, 1)
          )
        ),
        infer = TRUE,
        adjust = "none"
      )
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        factor = fac,
        time_difference = estimate,
        time_standard_error = SE,
        time_df = df,
        time_t_ratio = t.ratio,
        p_value = p.value
      )

    list(
      means = time_means,
      test = time_test
    )
  }
)

############################################################
# 2. Combine results across factors
############################################################

time_mean_plot_data <- time_plot_results %>%
  compact() %>%
  map_dfr("means")

time_association_tests <- time_plot_results %>%
  compact() %>%
  map_dfr("test") %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    significance = case_when(
      adjusted_p_value < .001 ~ "***",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.10  ~ ".",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    )
  )

############################################################
# 3. Join p-values to plotting data
############################################################

time_mean_plot_data <- time_mean_plot_data %>%
  left_join(
    time_association_tests %>%
      select(
        factor,
        p_value,
        adjusted_p_value,
        significance
      ),
    by = "factor"
  )

############################################################
# 4. Create one annotation per factor
############################################################

time_annotations <- time_mean_plot_data %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  summarise(
    max_ci = max(
      ci_upper,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    min_ci = min(
      ci_lower,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    p_value = first(p_value),
    adjusted_p_value = first(adjusted_p_value),
    significance = first(significance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    factor_range = max_ci - min_ci,

    factor_range = if_else(
      is.finite(factor_range) &
        factor_range > 0,
      factor_range,
      1
    ),

    annotation_y =
      max_ci + 0.15 * factor_range,

    annotation_label = paste0(
      significance
      )
  )

############################################################
# 5. Order factors numerically
############################################################

factor_levels <- time_mean_plot_data %>%
  distinct(factor) %>%
  mutate(
    factor_number = as.numeric(
      gsub(
        "[^0-9]",
        "",
        as.character(factor)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor_number) %>%
  pull(factor) %>%
  as.character()

time_mean_plot_data <- time_mean_plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    factor = factor(
      as.character(factor),
      levels = factor_levels
    ),
    Time = factor(
      Time,
      levels = time_levels
    )
  )

time_annotations <- time_annotations %>%
  mutate(
    factor = factor(
      as.character(factor),
      levels = factor_levels
    )
  )

############################################################
# 6. Bar plot: estimated mean score and 95% CI
############################################################

factor_time_barplot <- ggplot(
  time_mean_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = factor,
    y = mean_factor_score,
    fill = Time
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = ci_lower,
      ymax = ci_upper
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = time_annotations,
    aes(
      x = factor,
      y = annotation_y,
      label = annotation_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +

  # Map colors to the actual values Base and End,
  # but display age labels in the plot legend.
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = c(
      "Base",
      "End"
    ),
    values = c(
      "Base" = "orange",
      "End" = "blue"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Base" = "5-months-old",
      "End" = "12-months-old"
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.08, 0.22)
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "MOFA factor",
    y = "Mean factor score (95% CI)",
    fill = "Age"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 20,
      r = 10,
      b = 10,
      l = 10
    )
  )

factor_time_barplot
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Select top 10 loadings within each factor AND omics view
#
# Ranking by absolute loading captures the features that
# contribute most strongly to the factor regardless of
# whether their loading is positive or negative.
############################################################

top10_time_factor_loadings <- time_factor_loadings %>%
  group_by(
    factor,
    view
  ) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = absolute_loading,
    n = 100,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor,
    view,
    desc(absolute_loading)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    loading_direction = case_when(
      loading > 0 ~ "Positive",
      loading < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE        ~ "Zero"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

############################################################

  left_join(
    time_association_tests %>%
      select(
        factor,
        time_difference,
        p_value,
        adjusted_p_value
      ),
    by = "factor"
```

```{r}
      na.rm = TRUE

      0.99,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
```

```{r}
############################################################
# 7. Test Group × Time interaction across all MOFA factors
############################################################

interaction_tests <- map_dfr(
  unique(factor_scores$factor),
  function(fac) {

    dat <- factor_scores %>%
      filter(
        factor == fac,
        !is.na(value),
        !is.na(Time),
        !is.na(Group),
        !is.na(ID)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Time = factor(
          Time,
          levels = time_levels
        ),
        Group = factor(Group),
        ID = factor(ID)
      )

    if (
      nrow(dat) < 10 ||
      n_distinct(dat$ID) < 5 ||
      n_distinct(dat$Time) < 2 ||
      n_distinct(dat$Group) < 2
    ) {
      return(tibble())
    }

    fit <- lmer(
      value ~ Group * Time + (1 | ID),
      data = dat,
      REML = FALSE
    )

    # Type III test of the Group × Time interaction
    interaction_anova <- anova(
      fit,
      type = 3
    )

    interaction_row <- interaction_anova[
      rownames(interaction_anova) == "Group:Time",
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    tibble(
      factor = fac,
      interaction_F = interaction_row$`F value`,
      numerator_df = interaction_row$NumDF,
      denominator_df = interaction_row$DenDF,
      p_value = interaction_row$`Pr(>F)`
    )
  }
) %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    significance = case_when(
      adjusted_p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.10  ~ ".",
      TRUE                     ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(adjusted_p_value)

interaction_tests
```

```{r}
############################################################
# 8. Test main effect of Diet across all MOFA factors
############################################################

diet_tests <- map_dfr(
  unique(factor_scores$factor),
  function(fac) {

    dat <- factor_scores %>%
      filter(
        factor == fac,
        !is.na(value),
        !is.na(Time),
        !is.na(Group),
        !is.na(ID)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Time = factor(
          Time,
          levels = time_levels
        ),
        Group = factor(
          Group,
          levels = c("Dairy", "Meat")
        ),
        ID = factor(ID)
      )

    if (
      nrow(dat) < 10 ||
      n_distinct(dat$ID) < 5 ||
      n_distinct(dat$Time) < 2 ||
      n_distinct(dat$Group) < 2
    ) {
      return(tibble())
    }

    ##########################################################
    # Repeated-measures model
    ##########################################################

    fit <- lmer(
      value ~ Group * Time + (1 | ID),
      data = dat,
      REML = FALSE
    )

    ##########################################################
    # Type III test of main Diet effect
    ##########################################################

    diet_anova <- anova(
      fit,
      type = 3
    )

    diet_row <- diet_anova[
      rownames(diet_anova) == "Group",
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    tibble(
      factor = fac,
      diet_F = diet_row$`F value`,
      numerator_df = diet_row$NumDF,
      denominator_df = diet_row$DenDF,
      p_value = diet_row$`Pr(>F)`
    )
  }
) %>%

  ############################################################
  # BH/FDR correction across all MOFA factors
  ############################################################

  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    significance = case_when(
      adjusted_p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.10  ~ ".",
      TRUE                     ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(adjusted_p_value)

diet_tests
```

```{r}
############################################################
# 8. Investigate the significant Group × Time interaction
#    for Factor5
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

factor_to_investigate <- "Factor5"

time_levels <- c("Base", "End")

############################################################
# Prepare Factor 5 data
############################################################

factor5_data <- factor_scores %>%
  filter(
    factor == factor_to_investigate,
    !is.na(value),
    !is.na(Time),
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(ID)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = factor(
      Time,
      levels = time_levels
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c("Dairy", "Meat")
    ),
    ID = factor(ID)
  )

############################################################
# Fit repeated-measures model
############################################################

factor5_fit <- lmer(
  value ~ Group * Time + (1 | ID),
  data = factor5_data,
  REML = FALSE
)

############################################################
# Model output and diagnostics
############################################################

summary(factor5_fit)

anova(
  factor5_fit,
  type = 3
)

isSingular(
  factor5_fit,
  tol = 1e-4
)

VarCorr(factor5_fit)

############################################################
# Estimated marginal means for every Group × Time
# combination
############################################################

factor5_emmeans <- emmeans(
  factor5_fit,
  specs = ~ Group * Time,
  weights = "equal"
)

factor5_emmeans_table <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    factor5_emmeans,
    infer = c(TRUE, FALSE),
    level = 0.95
  )
) %>%
  transmute(
    Group,
    Time,
    estimated_mean = emmean,
    standard_error = SE,
    degrees_freedom = df,
    ci_lower = lower.CL,
    ci_upper = upper.CL
  )

factor5_emmeans_table


############################################################
# Time effect within each diet group
#
# Tests:
#   End - Base within Dairy
#   End - Base within Meat
#
# Raw p-values are obtained first, followed by
# Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across BOTH tests.
############################################################

factor5_time_by_group <- emmeans(
  factor5_fit,
  specs = ~ Time | Group,
  weights = "equal"
)

factor5_time_contrasts <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    contrast(
      factor5_time_by_group,
      method = list(
        "End - Base" = c(-1, 1)
      ),
      by = "Group"
    ),
    infer = TRUE,
    adjust = "none"
  )
) %>%
  transmute(
    Group,
    contrast,
    estimate,
    standard_error = SE,
    degrees_freedom = df,
    t_ratio = t.ratio,
    p_value = p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),

    significance = case_when(
      adjusted_p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.10  ~ ".",
      TRUE                     ~ ""
    )
  )

factor5_time_contrasts


############################################################
# Diet-group difference within each timepoint
#
# Tests:
#   Meat versus Dairy at Base
#   Meat versus Dairy at End
#
# Raw p-values are obtained first, followed by
# Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across BOTH tests.
############################################################

factor5_group_by_time <- emmeans(
  factor5_fit,
  specs = ~ Group | Time,
  weights = "equal"
)

factor5_group_contrasts <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    pairs(
      factor5_group_by_time,
      adjust = "none"
    ),
    infer = TRUE
  )
) %>%
  transmute(
    Time,
    contrast,
    estimate,
    standard_error = SE,
    degrees_freedom = df,
    t_ratio = t.ratio,
    p_value = p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),

    significance = case_when(
      adjusted_p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.10  ~ ".",
      TRUE                     ~ ""
    )
  )

factor5_group_contrasts


############################################################
# Direct difference-in-differences interaction contrast
#
# This quantifies:
#
#   (End - Base in one diet group)
#      minus
#   (End - Base in the other diet group)
#
# This is a single contrast for Factor 5, so no
# within-Factor-5 multiple-testing adjustment is required.
#
# The interaction p-values across ALL MOFA factors should
# instead be BH-adjusted in the separate interaction screen.
############################################################

factor5_interaction_contrast <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    contrast(
      factor5_time_by_group,
      method = "revpairwise",
      by = NULL
    ),
    infer = TRUE,
    adjust = "none"
  )
)

factor5_interaction_contrast


############################################################
# Prepare plot annotations
#
# Stars represent the BH-adjusted End - Base comparison
# within each diet group.
############################################################

factor5_annotations <- factor5_emmeans_table %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    annotation_y = max(
      ci_upper,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    group_range =
      max(
        ci_upper,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) -
      min(
        ci_lower,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    factor5_time_contrasts %>%
      select(
        Group,
        p_value,
        adjusted_p_value,
        significance
      ),
    by = "Group"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group_range = if_else(
      is.finite(group_range) &
        group_range > 0,
      group_range,
      1
    ),

    annotation_y =
      annotation_y +
      0.12 * group_range,

    annotation_time = factor(
      "End",
      levels = time_levels
    )
  )

factor5_annotations


############################################################
# Interaction plot
#
# Estimated marginal means and 95% confidence intervals.
# Significance symbols indicate BH-adjusted changes
# from 5 to 12 months within each diet group.
############################################################

factor5_interaction_plot <- ggplot(
  factor5_emmeans_table,
  aes(
    x = Time,
    y = estimated_mean,
    group = Group,
    color = Group
  )
) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = ci_lower,
      ymax = ci_upper
    ),
    width = 0.10,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = factor5_annotations,
    aes(
      x = annotation_time,
      y = annotation_y,
      label = significance,
      color = Group
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = c(
      "Base",
      "End"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Base" = "5-months-old",
      "End" = "12-months-old"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste0(
      factor_to_investigate,
      ": Diet × Age interaction"
    ),
    subtitle =
      "Estimated marginal means and 95% confidence intervals",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Mean factor score",
    color = "Diet group"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.08, 0.18)
    )
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 20,
      r = 10,
      b = 10,
      l = 10
    )
  )

factor5_interaction_plot


############################################################
# Optional: inspect individual paired observations
############################################################

factor5_individual_plot <- ggplot(
  factor5_data,
  aes(
    x = Time,
    y = value,
    group = ID,
    color = Group
  )
) +

  geom_line(
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.45,
    size = 1.5
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ Group
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = c(
      "Base",
      "End"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Base" = "5-months-old",
      "End" = "12-months-old"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste0(

    ),
    x = "Age",

  theme_classic(

  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 6. Convert microbiome to matrix
# -----------------------------

micro_mat <- micro %>%
  mutate(sample = paste0(as.character(sample_ID), "_", Time)) %>%
  select(sample, all_of(micro_feature_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(micro_feature_cols), ~ as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(micro_feature_cols), ~ replace_na(., 0)))

# Save sample names before converting to a matrix
micro_sample_names <- micro_mat$sample

micro_mat <- micro_mat %>%
  select(-sample) %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(micro_mat) <- "double"
rownames(micro_mat) <- micro_sample_names

# CLR transform using a fixed pseudocount for zero values
clr_transform <- function(x) {
  x[!is.finite(x)] <- NA_real_

  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  }

  # Replace observed zeros only; NA values remain NA
  x[x == 0 & !is.na(x)] <- 1e-6

  # Log-transform values
  lx <- log(x)

  # Center the logged values within the sample
  clr_values <- lx - mean(lx, na.rm = TRUE)

  return(clr_values)
}

micro_clr <- t(apply(micro_mat, 1, clr_transform))

# Restore feature and sample names
colnames(micro_clr) <- colnames(micro_mat)
rownames(micro_clr) <- rownames(micro_mat)

# MOFA expects features in rows and samples in columns
micro_view <- t(micro_clr)
```

```{r}
# 6. Align both views to the same sample universe ------------------------------

sample_ids_unique <- unique(append(rownames(metab_mat), rownames(micro_mat)))
sample_ids_unique_ordered <- sample_ids_unique[order(sample_ids_unique)]


align_view <- function(view_matrix, sample_ids) {
  aligned <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(view_matrix),
    ncol = length(sample_ids),
    dimnames = list(rownames(view_matrix), sample_ids)
  )

  shared <- intersect(colnames(view_matrix), sample_ids)
  aligned[, shared] <- view_matrix[, shared, drop = FALSE]
  aligned
}

metab_view_filled <- align_view(metab_view, sample_ids_unique_ordered)
micro_view_filled <- align_view(micro_view, sample_ids_unique_ordered)

)

  identical(colnames(mofa_data$Metabolomics), sample_ids_unique_ordered),

)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

library(purrr)

library(broom.mixed)

############################################################
# Settings
############################################################

output_dir <- paste0(

  "Current_Code&Workflow/Final_Manuscript_Figures/MOFA2/",

dir.create(

  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# FDR threshold for association between factor score and diet
factor_fdr_threshold <- 0.05


# Expected diet groups
diet_groups <- c("Meat", "Dairy")

############################################################
# 1. Extract factor scores and attach metadata
############################################################

factor_scores <- get_factors(
  MOFAmodel,
  factors = "all",
  as.data.frame = TRUE
) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_metadata %>%
      select(
        sample,
        ID,
        Group,
        Time
      ) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Group %in% diet_groups,
    !is.na(value)
  )

############################################################
# 2. Check factor and group names
############################################################

print(unique(factor_scores$factor))
print(unique(factor_scores$Group))



############################################################
#  Test factor-score association with diet
#
# factor score ~ Group
############################################################

test_factor_group_association <- function(factor_name) {

  dat <- factor_scores %>%
    filter(factor == factor_name) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = factor(
        Group,
        levels = c("Dairy", "Meat")
      )
    )

  model <- lm(
    value ~ Group,
    data = dat
  )

  broom::tidy(model) %>%
    filter(term == "GroupMeat") %>%
    transmute(
      factor = factor_name,
      estimate_meat_minus_dairy = estimate,
      standard_error = std.error,
      statistic = statistic,
      p_value = p.value
    )
}

factor_association_tests <- map_dfr(
  unique(factor_scores$factor),
  test_factor_group_association
) %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )
```

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

############################################################
# Mean factor scores by diet with 95% confidence intervals
############################################################

factor_plot_data <- factor_scores %>%
  filter(
    Group %in% c("Meat", "Dairy"),
    !is.na(value)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    factor,
    Group
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n_distinct(sample),
    mean_factor_score = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_factor_score = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_factor_score = sd_factor_score / sqrt(n),

    # 95% CI using the group-specific t distribution
    t_critical = qt(
      p = 0.975,
      df = n - 1
    ),

    ci_lower =
      mean_factor_score -
      t_critical * se_factor_score,

    ci_upper =
      mean_factor_score +
      t_critical * se_factor_score,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    factor_summary %>%
      select(
        factor,
        p_value,
        adjusted_p_value
      ),
    by = "factor"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      adjusted_p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      adjusted_p_value < 0.10  ~ ".",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    )
  )

############################################################
# One p-value annotation per factor
############################################################

factor_annotations <- factor_plot_data %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  summarise(
    max_ci = max(ci_upper, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ci = min(ci_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value = first(p_value),
    adjusted_p_value = first(adjusted_p_value),
    significance = first(significance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    factor_range = max_ci - min_ci,

    # Prevent zero or non-finite annotation spacing
    factor_range = if_else(
      is.finite(factor_range) & factor_range > 0,
      factor_range,
      1
    ),

    annotation_y =
      max_ci + 0.15 * factor_range,

    annotation_label = paste0(
      significance
      )
    
  )

############################################################
# Order factors numerically
############################################################

factor_levels <- factor_plot_data %>%
  distinct(factor) %>%
  mutate(
    factor_number = as.numeric(
      gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(factor))
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor_number) %>%
  pull(factor) %>%
  as.character()

factor_plot_data <- factor_plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    factor = factor(
      as.character(factor),
      levels = factor_levels
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c("Dairy", "Meat")
    )
  )

factor_annotations <- factor_annotations %>%
  mutate(
    factor = factor(
      as.character(factor),
      levels = factor_levels
    )
  )

############################################################
# Bar plot
############################################################

factor_score_barplot <- ggplot(
  factor_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = factor,
    y = mean_factor_score,
    fill = Group
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = ci_lower,
      ymax = ci_upper
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = factor_annotations,
    aes(
      x = factor,
      y = annotation_y,
      label = annotation_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Dairy" = "darkgreen",
      "Meat" = "maroon"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.08, 0.22)
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "MOFA factor",
    y = "Mean factor score (95% CI)",
    fill = "Diet group"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 20,
      r = 10,
      b = 10,
      l = 10
    )
  )

factor_score_barplot
```
